scrape() rejects loopback addresses by default SSRF policy

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    try {
      final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"ssrf_deny_private_explicit":true}');
      final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
      final url = 'http://127.0.0.1:9/';
      final result = await CrawlbergBridge.scrape(engine, url);
      stdout.writeln(result);
    } on Error catch (error) {
      stderr.writeln('${error.runtimeType}: $error');
    }
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
